meta.status: W-01 is ADDRESSED-GATED. The method for replacing city/county proxies with trade-area figures is specified and the official instruments are named. The execution is blocked because selecting Census tracts requires the parcel's location, which is withheld under the privacy rule.
meta.why_it_matters: A county unemployment rate of 4.6% and a city median income of $81,939 describe 4 million people. A QSR's trade area is roughly a 1 to 3 mile drive-time ring containing perhaps 40,000 to 120,000 people. Using the container figure as if it were the trade-area figure is the most common way a ground-lease analysis goes wrong - it averages away the only thing that matters.

official_instruments.action: Geocode the parcel to latitude/longitude using the County's own parcel layer, not a commercial geocoder
Assign the containing 2020 Census tract and all tracts whose centroid falls inside the drive-time ring
official_instruments.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line and 2020 tract boundaries

official_instruments.action: Pull ACS 5-year estimates for the selected tracts; use 5-year not 1-year because a 1-3 mile ring of tracts will fall below the 65,000 population threshold for 1-year estimates
Weight each tract by the share of its population inside the ring, not by tract area
Hold the 2020 tract vintage fixed for the whole analysis so that trend comparisons are not contaminated by boundary changes

tract_selection_method.verified_constraint: The Census data API returned 'Missing Key' when queried without a key during this session, so no programmatic ACS pull is available. Figures must be read from published tables.

container_figures_do_not_substitute.note: A city-wide decline is consistent with a growing trade area, or the reverse. The container figure cannot tell you which.

trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: Execute tract_selection_method steps 1-4 against ACS table B01003.
ACS table B19013 over the selected tract set.
ACS table B19001 or B19025. The distribution matters more than the median for a value QSR.
LEHD OnTheMap workplace-area characteristics for the tract set.

trade_area_rows.metric: Households without a vehicle (walk-in trade potential)
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: ACS table B25044 over the tract set.

trade_area_rows.metric: Traffic counts on the abutting street
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: City of Los Angeles or Caltrans published annual average daily traffic (AADT) for the specific segment.

trade_area_rows.metric: School system quality indicators serving the ring
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: California Department of Education DataQuest for the assigned schools; California School Dashboard for accountability indicators.
trade_area_rows.note: The brief explicitly asks for school systems. No school figure is published here because none was verified against an official CDE page in this session. Flagged I-05.

trade_area_rows.metric: Competing QSR units within the ring
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: Brand locator counts cross-checked against municipal business-licence data. Brand locators are commercial, not official, so they can only generate a lead to be confirmed against a public record.

trade_area_rows.metric: Zoning and permitted-use status of the parcel
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: Los Angeles City Planning ZIMAS parcel report.
trade_area_rows.note: Determines whether the box can be re-let to a non-QSR use and at what cost. Absolutely decisive for exit value.

trade_area_rows.metric: Overlay / specific plan / community plan designation
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: ZIMAS and the applicable community plan.
trade_area_rows.official_source: City of Los Angeles City Planning

trade_area_rows.metric: Planned public investment within the ring (transit stations, street projects)
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: Metro project pages and the City capital programme.
trade_area_rows.official_source: LA Metro / City of Los Angeles

trade_area_rows.metric: Tract-level trend evidence (income, population, employment over time)
trade_area_rows.how_to_obtain: ACS 5-year 2015-2019, 2016-2020, 2017-2021, 2018-2022, 2019-2023 for the same tract set, compared on constant 2020 boundaries.
trade_area_rows.note: R-14 requires tract-level trend evidence alongside regional figures. It cannot be produced without the tract set. Flagged.
